name: Green River (Dinosaur National Monument)
blurb: Canyon of Lodore, Whirlpool and Split Mountain canyons in Dinosaur National Monument. NPS permit required for every trip.

sections.notes: NPS multiday permit (lottery; $185 + $15 application). Starts in Colorado. NPS: 44 miles; 'Normal trip lengths are 4 days (3 nights) on the Green River' in high-use season. Gauge at Jensen is downstream of the Yampa confluence (Echo Park); Lodore Canyon flow is roughly the Greendale release.

guideTimes.conditions: Normal Green River high-use-season trip length in the 2025 NPS regulations: four days, three nights. This is a permitted itinerary, not hours afloat. Check current permit conditions.
guideTimes.sourceName: NPS Boating in the Monument, 2025 regulations

notices.title: Whitewater experience required
notices.text: NPS warns that rapids can reach Class IV depending on water level and that trip leaders and boat operators need experience on comparable rivers. The dotted line shows the general river corridor, not a route through individual rapids.
notices.sourceName: National Park Service — private river trips

timing.note: A reviewed speed/flow calibration has not been established. Access and guide information remain available.
